# Deployment Checklist: React Frontend Web Deployment Workflow

**Purpose**: Validate that the frontend deployment workflow requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and ready for implementation review.
**Created**: 2026-05-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the workflow file name, repository location, and frontend application path fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all required workflow triggers documented, including automatic `main` pushes and manual dispatch? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are dependency installation, build, authentication, and deployment phases all represented as explicit requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all required GitHub secrets and variables named in the requirements with their intended purpose? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK005 Are environment-specific deployment requirements complete for `dev`, `qa`, and `prod`, or is the missing `qa` SKU policy explicitly intentional? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for how the workflow identifies the correct Azure Static Web Apps resource for each environment? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the phrase "same environment variable pattern as the infrastructure workflow" clarified with all required variables and defaulting rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the concurrency behavior stated with the exact grouping basis and cancellation rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "deploy only the generated `dist/` build output" defined precisely enough to exclude source files and unintended directories? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the role of `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` limited clearly to the Static Web Apps repository token use case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "fail fast" defined with the specific phases where failure must stop later deployment reporting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "clear error" defined with objective criteria for missing or invalid secrets? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do trigger, environment, and defaulting requirements align between automatic push and manual dispatch scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the secret requirements align with the security requirement prohibiting hard-coded credentials and tokens? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the SKU requirement align with the stated assumption that SKU assignment is handled by provisioning rather than this deployment workflow? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the success criteria for deployment output align with the functional requirement to publish only `dist/`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the action version requirements consistent between the specification, implementation plan, and repository standards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Technical Context]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are success criteria measurable for workflow start rate, deployment duration, manual dispatch timing, concurrency, artifact scope, credential review, failure reporting, and SKU readiness? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001-SC-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Can the 10-minute deployment target be measured from a clearly defined start and end point? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Can the manual deployment start target be measured without ambiguity about operator steps or timing boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is SKU readiness review defined with enough evidence requirements to objectively satisfy environment readiness? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK022 Are failure outcomes described so a reviewer can distinguish expected failure reporting from a successful deployment state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary flow requirements complete for `main` push deployments from build through Azure Static Web Apps publication? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-007-FR-011]
- [ ] CHK024 Are alternate flow requirements complete for manual dispatch across `dev`, `qa`, and `prod`? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK025 Are exception flow requirements complete for dependency installation, build, Azure login, and Static Web Apps deployment failures? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery-oriented requirements defined for redeployment after failed deployment or configuration updates? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK027 Are concurrency scenarios defined for rapid successive pushes, including which run remains eligible to continue? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements specified for missing manual environment input and the `dev` default behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified for missing or invalid `AZURE_CREDENTIALS` and `AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN` separately? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements specified for missing or invalid `VITE_API_URL` and `APP_NAME` variables? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements specified for absent or invalid frontend lockfile/build script inputs used by `npm ci` and `npm run build`? [Gap, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements specified for preserving the previously deployed site when build or deployment preparation fails? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
